nodes.summary: For a natural number $d$, $E_d$ is the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^d$, the real $d$-tuples with the Euclidean norm.
nodes.title: Euclidean model space for the shadowing lemma

nodes.summary: Let $T : \mathbb{R}^d \to \mathbb{R}^d$ be a map, write $T^n$ for its $n$-fold iterate, and let $K \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$. The set $K$ has the shadowing property for $T$ if there is an open set $U \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$ containing $K$ such that for every $\delta > 0$ there is $\varepsilon > 0$ with the following property: for every $\varepsilon$-pseudo orbit $(x_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ of $T$ with $x_n \in U$ for…
nodes.title: Shadowing property

nodes.summary: Let $T : \mathbb{R}^d \to \mathbb{R}^d$ be a homeomorphism and let $K \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$ be a compact set that is a hyperbolic invariant set for $T$. Then $K$ has the shadowing property for $T$.
nodes.title: Anosov–Bowen shadowing lemma

nodes.summary: Let $T : \mathbb{R}^d \to \mathbb{R}^d$ be a homeomorphism and let $K \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$. Write $DF_x$ for the derivative of a map $F$ at $x$, $T^n$ for the $n$-fold iterate of $T$ and $T^{-n}$ for the $n$-fold iterate of $T^{-1}$. nodes.title: Hyperbolic structure

nodes.summary: Let $T : \mathbb{R}^d \to \mathbb{R}^d$ be a homeomorphism. A set $K \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$ is a hyperbolic invariant set for $T$ if there exists a hyperbolic structure for $T$ on $K$.
nodes.title: Hyperbolic invariant set

nodes.summary: Let $d$ be a natural number, let $\mathbb{R}^d$ carry the Euclidean norm, let $T : \mathbb{R}^d \to \mathbb{R}^d$ be a map and let $\varepsilon$ be a real number. A sequence $(x_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ in $\mathbb{R}^d$ is an $\varepsilon$-pseudo orbit of $T$ if $\|x_{n+1} - T(x_n)\| < \varepsilon$ for every $n \in \mathbb{N}$.
nodes.title: Pseudo-orbit

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
